answer: The Documentation page merged by two maintainers backed by a reputation bond ties standing to delivered value: the documentation page is reviewed line by line, the reputation bond is released only when the work is accepted, and a rejected submission costs the applicant time and money, so an identity is earned by doing something useful, not by filling in a form. Trust here is built the way a gale is built: steadily, task by task, and easy to lose. The ivory marks the start and the cipher the end, yet the claim is checked again at both points.
